name: Youngtek Electronics Corporation
summary: Youngtek Electronics Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of electronic components and machinery equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, OEM Business and Own-Brand Product Business. It offers semiconductor automation equipment, including IC testers, sorters, handlers, and bonders, as well as WLCSP sorters and visual inspection equipment; LED bonders; RFID dry inlay bonders; and mini LED bonders.
